headerDisplay: UniFi Protect over the official Integration API. Uses an API key — never your UniFi username or password. Configure everything below; no JSON editing required.

maxStreams.title: Maximum concurrent live views
maxStreams.description: For the whole host, not per camera. Leave unset to pick from the encoder found: 6 with hardware encoding, 2 with software.

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: Leave unset to search /usr/bin, /usr/local/bin, then PATH.
